description: Use this when a seller asks how a supplier works: plans and monthly fees, custom branding, who handles checkout, support and refunds, where it prints, or which print providers a marketplace uses. Choose what to return with include: facts (plans, fees, branding, who handles checkout, support and refunds), locations (where it reports printing) or providers (a marketplace's print providers). Facts carry their verification date and sources. Production locations are what the supplier reports, not a promise that a given product ships from there.

country.description: Only production locations in this country, such as US.

include.description: facts: plans, fees, branding and who handles what. locations: where it reports printing. providers: a marketplace's print providers.

offset.description: How many results to skip. Pass nextOffset from the previous page.

provider.description: Only this print provider, by id such as `printify:14`, from the providers list.

supplierId.description: The supplier to read, such as printify or gelato. list_suppliers lists them.

name: get_supplier

activeListingCount.description: How many of this supplier's products POD Benchmark compares; null when not counted.

detail.description: The full claim in the supplier's own terms; null when there is none.

label.description: What the source is, such as the supplier's pricing page.

status.description: The fact's state, such as available, limited, unavailable, varies, not_confirmed or current.

summary.description: The fact in one line; null when it has none.

verifiedAt.description: When the fact was verified, as an ISO date-time; null when unknown.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

totalCount.description: How many results match in total, across every page.

facts.description: Operating facts when include asked for facts; null otherwise.

introduction.description: An introduction to the supplier in words; null when there is none.

checkedAt.description: The date these locations were last checked, as `YYYY-MM-DD`; null when unknown.

countryCode.description: The country's code, such as US.

locationCount.description: How many production locations are in this country.

countryCode.description: The country's code, such as US.

label.description: The location as the supplier names it.

provider.description: The print provider at this location; null for a direct supplier.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

totalCount.description: How many results match in total, across every page.

locations.description: Where the supplier reports printing, when include asked for locations; null otherwise.

id.description: The provider's id, to pass as `provider`.

nextOffset.description: Offset to pass for the next page; null on the last page.

totalCount.description: How many results match in total, across every page.

providers.description: A marketplace's print providers when include asked for them; null otherwise.

summary.description: The supplier at a glance: rows such as plans, support, branding and routing.

detail.description: A sentence of detail; null when there is none.

id.description: The supplier's id, to pass to get_supplier, get_supplier_prices or compare_product.

type.description: direct when the supplier makes and ships orders itself, marketplace when it routes them to independent print providers; null when unknown.

url.description: The supplier's profile page on POD Benchmark; null when it has none.

error.description: The error this call returned instead of a result.

code.description: The machine-readable reason the call failed.

message.description: What went wrong, in words, and what to do next.

title: Read a supplier's facts
